theme: A clear day inside the Croatia countdown — six days to wheels-up.
greeting: Nothing sits on the calendar today, so the open hours are yours. But the trip clock is loud: Croatia is six days out, tomorrow you change houses, and a short stack of P1 bookings still needs closing before you lose connectivity at sea.

needsAttention.title: Croatia's last night still isn't booked
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 19 Cavtat hotel and the noon marina transfer from Komolac have to be booked from dry land — charter connectivity is nil once you sail on the 12th. Book refundable.

needsAttention.title: Confirm checked bags are on the Croatia ticket
needsAttention.detail: The issued fare shows zero checked bags. Verify on Eurowings Discover's own site and pre-buy — two 55L duffels won't pass as carry-on and counter fees run far higher.

needsAttention.title: Pack the travel larder bin
needsAttention.detail: Tomorrow's move to the St. Pete Ranch is the first Airbnb changeover, so the bin needs building before then to make the first migration the test run while there's still time to fix it.

needsAttention.title: Book the Sept 20–22 St. Pete gap
needsAttention.detail: The two nights between landing from Croatia and the Tuesday kid pickup are still unbooked; the Orlando villa doesn't start until the 22nd.

needsAttention.title: Send your bio to Ellen and Deb
needsAttention.detail: Your own note to send an email address and bio to Ellen and Deb is still sitting unread in the inbox.

flagged.detail: LinkedIn surfaced a Head of US Public Policy / SVP opening at Block.
